changes.result: Introduced one internal typed disposition with Blocking, OpenMigrationObligation, and Informational states. Severity is evaluated before code, so an error can never be laundered by an obligation code.
InventoryClosureStatus-v2 now exposes separate blocker and open-obligation counts and sorted per-code maps; only blocker count controls Closed versus Blocked.
Closure projection reads findings immutably. The live test compares AuthorityCatalog canonical bytes before and after closure projection and retains exactly 81 finding rows.

Exact tests cover same-code errors, unknown warnings, candidate warnings, informational rows, zero blockers with 47 open obligations, route failures, stale and unsafe activation evidence, generated drift, and exact current 81/34/47 accounting.

Open migration obligations are non-blocking only in closure arithmetic. They remain visible and keep their separate migration and retirement obligations open.
The accepted test closure excludes two source-stale broader diagnostics owned by other lanes; both are reported explicitly rather than hidden or weakened.
Worker evidence is source and isolated-test evidence. Root must independently review, integrate, recompute the candidate, and run the final HCT-INVENTORY summaries.
